tag: 正是簡報與樣品交叉解說.

level.why: 全文以祈使句、步驟說明與 let me show you 等簡報固定句型為主，句子簡短易懂；但包含 align、swivel、maneuver、latch 等產品機構字彙，且需追蹤影片與樣品交叉示範的安裝、反轉、橫向移動與摺疊多個步驟，屬於 B1+ 程度。

passage:
OK, let's take a look at Magic Connect.

First, let me show you how people normally attach or reverse a stroller seat.

As you can see in this video, this lady is reversing the seat with both hands.

She needs to carefully align both sides of the seat with two separate adapters before locking it into place.

And in this next video, that's me using another stroller.

Even though I'm more familiar with strollers, I still need both hands to align the seat and get it into place.

So, this is exactly the problem we're trying to solve with Magic Connect.

The idea is simple. We want to make attaching and reversing the seat easier and more intuitive.

It's so easy that you can even do it with just one hand.

Now, let me show you how it works.

This is one of our colleagues from the finance department trying out Magic Connect.

As you can see, she can easily reverse the seat and attach it to the frame with just one hand, while holding her baby with the other.

Now, let's take a look at the sample.

Some of you may have already seen or tried it, so let me walk you through how it works.

First, let me show you how to attach the seat to the Magic Connect frame.

As you can see, I simply lower the seat onto the guide, and it automatically locks into place.

That's it. No need to align two separate adapters.

Now, let me show you how to reverse the seat.

First, rotate the button here and push the backrest forward until it's upright, then push it a little further.

You'll feel the mechanism release.

Then, release the button and grab the backrest tube.

Lift the seat, rotate it to the other direction, and lower it back onto the guide.

It automatically locks into place again.

That's it. Simple and intuitive.

Now, let's move on to the next feature: sideways movement.

This feature is especially useful when parents need to move the stroller sideways in tight spaces, such as crowded stores or narrow aisles.

Let me show you a video to give you a better idea of how it works.

As you can see, sideways movement makes it easier to maneuver the stroller in tight spaces.

Now, let me explain how to activate this feature.

Simply press and hold this button on the handlebar to release the rear wheel swivel locks.

This allows the rear wheels to swivel freely, so you can move the stroller sideways.

When you're done, just release the button, and the rear wheels return to their normal locked position for regular steering.

Although this feature is already available on some competing strollers, we've developed a different mechanism to achieve the same function.

Now, let's move on to the folding feature.

Let me show you a video of how it works.

The stroller can be folded with the seat facing either forward or backward, so there's no need to change the seat direction before folding.

Now, let me show you how to fold it with the sample.

First, fold the backrest down.

Then, press the handlebar button and lower the handlebar to its lowest position.

When the handlebar is fully lowered, push it a little further to release the frame lock.

Once the frame is unlocked, rotate the handlebar downward.

As you do this, the seat will automatically unlock and rotate down.

Next, lift the handle behind the seat.

The weight of the stroller helps the frame and seat fold together into a compact package.

Once folded, the stroller can stand on its own.

Now, let me show you how to unfold it.

This sample doesn't have a fold latch yet, so there's no latch to release.

Simply unfold the stroller directly.

To sum up, there are three key features of this stroller.

First, the Magic Connect system makes seat attachment and reversal more intuitive.

Second, sideways movement helps parents maneuver in tight spaces.

And third, compact folding allows the stroller to fold down into a compact, self-standing package.

Any questions so far?

OK, if there are no questions, let's move on to the next topic.
zh:
好的，我們來看看 Magic Connect。

首先，讓我示範一般人是如何安裝或反轉推車座椅的。

如同各位在這段影片中看到的，這位女士正用雙手反轉座椅。

她必須小心地將座椅兩側對準兩個分開的接座，才能把座椅鎖定到位。

接下來這段影片，是我在使用另一台推車。

雖然我對推車比較熟悉，但我還是需要用雙手才能對準座椅並把它裝到定位。

所以，這正是我們想用 Magic Connect 解決的問題。

概念很簡單。我們希望讓座椅的安裝與反轉更容易、更直覺。

它簡單到你甚至只用一隻手就能完成。

現在，讓我示範它是如何運作的。

這是我們財務部門的一位同事，正在試用 Magic Connect。

如同各位所見，她只用一隻手就能輕鬆反轉座椅並把它裝到車架上，同時另一隻手還能抱著她的寶寶。

接下來，我們來看看樣品。

各位當中有些人可能已經看過或試用過了，所以讓我帶大家了解它是如何運作的。

首先，讓我示範如何把座椅安裝到 Magic Connect 車架上。

如同各位所見，我只要把座椅放低到導軌上，它就會自動鎖定到位。

這樣就完成了。不需要再對準兩個分開的接座。

現在，讓我示範如何反轉座椅。

首先，轉動這裡的按鈕，把椅背向前推到直立，然後再多推一點。

你會感覺到機構鬆開。

接著，放開按鈕，抓住椅背管。

提起座椅，把它轉向另一個方向，再放回導軌上。

它會再次自動鎖定到位。

這樣就完成了。簡單又直覺。

現在，我們來看下一項功能：橫向移動。

當家長需要在狹窄空間裡讓推車橫向移動時，這項功能特別有用，例如擁擠的商店或狹窄的走道。

讓我播放一段影片，讓大家更清楚它是如何運作的。

如同各位所見，橫向移動讓推車在狹窄空間裡更容易操控。

現在，讓我說明如何啟動這項功能。

只要按住推把上的這個按鈕不放，就能解除後輪旋轉鎖。

這會讓後輪可以自由旋轉，所以你就能讓推車橫向移動。

完成後，只要放開按鈕，後輪就會回到正常的鎖定位置，以便一般的轉向。

雖然有些競爭對手的推車已經具備這項功能，但我們開發了不同的機構來達成相同的功能。

接下來，我們來看摺疊功能。

讓我播放一段影片，看看它是如何運作的。

這台推車不論座椅朝前或朝後都能摺疊，所以摺疊前不需要先改變座椅方向。

現在，讓我用樣品示範如何摺疊。

首先，把椅背向下摺。

然後，按下推把按鈕，把推把降到最低位置。

當推把完全降下後，再多推一點，以解除車架鎖定。

一旦車架解鎖，就把推把向下旋轉。

這麼做的時候，座椅會自動解鎖並向下轉。

接著，提起座椅後方的把手。

推車本身的重量會幫助車架與座椅一起摺成緊湊的一包。

摺疊後，推車可以自己站立。

現在，讓我示範如何展開。

這個樣品還沒有摺疊閂鎖，所以沒有需要解除的閂鎖。

直接把推車展開就可以了。

總結來說，這台推車有三大主要功能。

第一，Magic Connect 系統讓座椅的安裝與反轉更直覺。

第二，橫向移動幫助家長在狹窄空間裡操控推車。

第三，緊湊摺疊讓推車能收合成一個緊湊、可自行站立的包裝。

目前大家有任何問題嗎？

好的，如果沒有問題，我們就進入下一個主題。

vocab.col: lock into place / fall into place
to sum up / sum up the main points

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the talk?
opts: To announce a recall of a baby stroller
To introduce a stroller with an easier seat system, sideways movement, and compact folding
To compare the prices of several competing strollers
To train employees in the finance department
why: 錯誤：講者沒有提到召回或任何產品問題，而是在介紹新功能。
正解：講者用影片和樣品說明座椅安裝與反轉、橫向移動與摺疊三大功能，最後也以 three key features 做總結。
錯誤：全文沒有提到任何價格，也沒有逐一比較其他推車。
錯誤：財務部門的同事只是在影片中試用 Magic Connect，並不是培訓對象。

questions.q: Why does the speaker mention that he is more familiar with strollers?
opts: To explain that he designed the competing product
To show that the video was filmed in a store
To prove that folding the stroller takes too long
To show that even an experienced person needs both hands with the current system
why: 錯誤：講者沒有說他設計過競爭產品。
錯誤：他只提到自己在影片中使用另一台推車，沒有說拍攝地點是商店。
錯誤：這句話談的是安裝座椅，與摺疊所需時間無關。
正解：講者說即使自己比較熟悉推車，仍需要雙手才能對準並裝好座椅，藉此說明現有系統的問題。

questions.q: According to the speaker, how can a user activate sideways movement?
opts: By pressing and holding a button on the handlebar
By rotating a button at the top of the backrest
By lifting the handle behind the seat
By pushing the handlebar a little further down
why: 正解：講者說只要按住推把上的按鈕，就能解除後輪旋轉鎖，讓推車橫向移動。
錯誤：轉動椅背上的按鈕是反轉座椅時的步驟，不是橫向移動。
錯誤：提起座椅後方的把手是摺疊的最後步驟。
錯誤：把推把再往下推一點是為了解除車架鎖定，用於摺疊。

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the sideways movement feature?
opts: No other stroller currently offers it
It uses the same mechanism as competing strollers
It is already available elsewhere, but his team developed a different mechanism
It works only when the seat is facing backward
why: 錯誤：講者說這項功能已有一些競爭對手的推車具備。
錯誤：講者說他們開發了不同的機構，而不是相同的機構。
正解：講者表示這項功能在一些競爭推車上已經有了，但他們開發了不同的機構來達成相同的功能。
錯誤：座椅方向與橫向移動無關，朝前或朝後的說法出現在摺疊功能中。

questions.q: The new software is so intuitive ______ even first-time users can learn it in a few minutes.
opts: that
what
which
how
why: 正解：so + 形容詞 + that 子句表示「如此……以致於……」，that 為正確連接詞。
錯誤：what 是關係代名詞或疑問詞，不能引導這種結果子句。
錯誤：which 需要先行詞，這裡 so intuitive 後不能接 which。
錯誤：how 引導疑問或方式子句，不符合 so...that 結構。

questions.q: Customers can compare our new model with other ______ products on the market.
opts: compete
competition
competing
competes
why: 錯誤：compete 是動詞原形，不能放在名詞 products 前修飾。
錯誤：competition 是名詞，不能直接修飾 products。
正解：competing 是現在分詞當形容詞，competing products 表示「相互競爭的產品」。
錯誤：competes 是第三人稱單數動詞，不能放在名詞前。

questions.q: Everyone on the design team is ______ with the new safety standards for baby products.
opts: familiarity
familiarize
familiarly
familiar
why: 錯誤：familiarity 是名詞，不能接在 is 後面作為這樣的補語。
錯誤：familiarize 是動詞，需用被動 be familiarized with 才通順。
錯誤：familiarly 是副詞，不能作主詞補語。
正解：be familiar with 表示「對……熟悉」，空格需要形容詞。

questions.q: The prototype will be ______ to the client for testing as soon as it is finished.
opts: deliver
delivery
delivering
delivered
why: 錯誤：will be 後面不能接動詞原形 deliver。
錯誤：delivery 是名詞，不能表示被送出的動作。
錯誤：delivering 是現在分詞，無法表達樣品「被送交」的被動意義。
正解：樣品是被送交的對象，用 will be + 過去分詞 delivered 的被動語態。

presentation_phrases.phrase: OK, let's take a look at Magic Connect.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 好的，我們來看看 Magic Connect。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於進入產品或主題介紹，把聽眾的注意力帶到要說明的對象。

presentation_phrases.phrase: First, let me show you how people normally attach or reverse a stroller seat.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 首先，讓我示範一般人是如何安裝或反轉推車座椅的。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於先說明現況或傳統做法，再帶出新設計要解決的問題。

presentation_phrases.phrase: As you can see in this video, she is reversing the seat with both hands.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 如同各位在這段影片中看到的，她正用雙手反轉座椅。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於播放影片後引導聽眾觀察重點。

presentation_phrases.phrase: So, this is exactly the problem we're trying to solve.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 所以，這正是我們想解決的問題。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於在展示現有痛點後，連結到自家產品的設計目的。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Let me walk you through how it works.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 讓我帶大家了解它是如何運作的。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於拿出樣品後，開始逐步說明操作方式。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Now, let's move on to the next feature.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 現在，我們來看下一項功能。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於從一個功能轉到下一個功能的過渡句。

presentation_phrases.phrase: To sum up, there are three key features of this stroller.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 總結來說，這台推車有三大主要功能。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於簡報結尾，統整前面介紹的重點。

presentation_phrases.meaning: 目前大家有任何問題嗎？
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於簡報告一段落時詢問聽眾意見，也可銜接進入問答或下一主題。
